references.text: Moses was also young when he acted against injustice, which shows the contrast to Jeter who feared because of his youth
Samuel hacked Agag into pieces, an act showing the execution of an enemy king, similar to what Gideon commanded Jeter to do with Sebah and Zalmunna
Solomon commanded Benaiah to kill Joab, a similar command to execute someone
Sebah and Zalmunna asked Gideon himself to kill them, because a man is known by his strength - this is a direct continuation of the story
Earlier in the chapter, Gideon chased Sebah and Zalmunna, who were now to be executed by his firstborn son
Abraham was commanded not to lay hands on his boy, a contrast to Gideon who commanded his young son to kill
